detail: Design for the server half of #31: (1) Decision gains optional superseded_by (src/utils/types.ts). (2) DecisionEngine.decide moved the supersede write AFTER decisionStore.create so the replacement id exists: updateStatus(input.supersedes, "superseded", { superseded_by: decision.id }). Side benefit: if create throws, the old decision is no longer left retired with no successor. The conflict scan now excludes entry.id === input.supersedes to preserve prior behavior (target was previously already flipped before the scan). (3) Housekeeping pass 9 backfills missing back-links: preview reports {fixed, dangling, items}, execute writes; target status is preserved (backfill fills the pointer, does not relitigate lifecycle); dangling supersedes targets counted+skipped. (4) why() surfaces superseded_by. (5) Migration verified safe by test: full Decision JSON round-trips export tree -> sqlite data blob -> reverse re-serialization; no schema column, matching how overridden_by/assumptions/provenance are stored. Note for crosspost-30/archive-35: my decisions.ts edits are at the supersede block + conflict filter + why(); housekeeping.ts edits are result-type field, init line, a self-contained pass-9 block, and two summary lines.
summary: #31 back-link: no IDecisionStore interface change needed — updateStatus(id, status, extra) already carries superseded_by through both backends; sqlite stores it in the decisions.data JSON blob
